notes: Account overview: mid-market B2B SaaS (product discovery widgets embedded in client apps). Heavy use of semantic search and personalized ranking across catalog + docs.
Current infra: Pg + pgvector for storage; nightly ETL that normalizes product metadata and reindexes vectors; also maintain a smaller Elastic fallback for boolean filters.
Data footprint: ~1.2M vectors today, expected +25k vectors/day during ramp; nightly batch jobs that write ~200k rows on big update windows.
Primary objectives: fast embeddings ingestion (sustained write throughput), sub-100ms 95th percentile query latency for top-k similarity, predictable unit cost for scaling to 5M vectors.

Performance targets discussed: embedding ingestion baseline 120 req/s sustained (API throughput), spike to 400 req/s during import windows; query QPS target 600 with p95 < 80ms for vector-only queries.
Model preferences: open/LLM-embeddings (cheap dense embeddings), willingness to try quantized variants for Dedicated to reduce cost; want routing/fallback to lower-cost models when load spikes.
Security / compliance: SSO/SAML required, SOC2 expected, audit logs for token-level access, KMS integration for key management, EU data residency for a subset of customers.

Decision criteria: 1) meet throughput/latency in realistic POC, 2) clear pricing on ingestion vs query cost, 3) legal sign-off on DPA + residency, 4) smooth integration w/ current ETL (Postgres+pgvector).
Quote from CTO (Ben Patel): "Latency under 100ms for product search is non-negotiable — if you can’t hit that on hosted, Dedicated is table stakes."
POC scope (agreed): Week1 - integration & small sample ingest; Week2 - full nightly batch ingest (200k); Week3 - load tests for query QPS and reranking; Week4 - results review + pricing conversation.
POC success metrics: sustained ingest >=120 req/s, p95 query latency <=80ms for 1k nearest neighbors at 1000 vectors/sec query load, cost per 1M tokens/embeds within target band.
Integration notes: will push Redwood client into ETL worker (Python), use streaming batch uploads; expect to validate prefix/KV caching for hot documents and tuning batching size.
Fallback policy ask: auto-route to quantized/gpu-cheaper model when queue length > threshold; want canary + automatic rollback on quality regressions.
Pricing: asked for example commitment tiers for Dedicated (reserved pool + burst); wants 12-month pricing and a short-term evaluation discount. AE to pull committed-pool options from pricing team.
Legal: sent security questionnaire (drive link above). Legal wants explicit data residency controls and a one-way export policy for EU customers.
Internal risks: engineering bandwidth limited in March — POC kickoff targeted early March; finance needs a mid-March budget review to approve mid-size commitment.
use_case_summary: Evaluate Redwood Hosted API for embeddings ingestion and semantic search ops; if latency/throughput meet SLAs, convert to Dedicated reserved capacity for cost predictability and VPC controls.
